QUOTE: Add the `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<REASON> -0xNNNN` in the module's public header (e.g. `include/mbedtls/<module>.h`)... Do not edit `library/error.c`. It is regenerated at build time. Rebuild and check that the new `case` appears
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says to add the documented #define to the public header, not edit error.c, and that it is regenerated by the generator at build time. The "re-run the generator" part is covered by the build-time regeneration.
